# tacps126

> Fast, low-cost web data tools published on Apify: jobs and hiring data, contact details, trade-show exhibitors and events, research papers and technology trends, reviews, news, Reddit, real estate and Shopify. Pay per result (about $1 per 1,000). Also an MCP server for AI agents.

- [Integrations](https://apirows.com/integrations.html): Clay recipes, AI agents over MCP, Hugging Face datasets, code recipes, n8n, Make, Zapier, Slack, webhooks and the REST API
- [MCP server (webdata-tools-mcp)](https://apirows.com/mcp.html): 45 tools for AI agents, MIT licensed, on npm and the official MCP Registry
- [All tools on Apify](https://apify.com/tacps126)
- [Code recipes](https://github.com/tacps126/apify-data-recipes)
- Contact: tacps126@gmail.com
